title: Automatic Preview Teardown Admission Tasks
principles: Use Alchemy pr-N stage isolation and TaxKit's exact-stage checks as the cleanup safety boundary.
Use one Preview credential environment for Preview deploy and teardown without changing Production.
Preserve historical receipts and keep teardown external proof open until a fresh default-branch run passes.

globalVerification.commitPolicy: Commit only after focused workflow, automation, documentation and full repository verification pass.
evidenceRequired: Names-only Preview environment secret and reviewer readback
Policy proof that Preview deploy and teardown share taxkit-docs-preview
Hosted pull-request Quality result for the candidate
Post-merge exact-stage teardown or no-op receipt before old-environment removal

downstreamArtifactImpact.surface: Workflow, live environment, policy and tests
downstreamArtifactImpact.verification: Names-only GitHub readback plus focused deployment checks.
nonClaims: No Cloudflare deployment or teardown is established by the settings readback.

downstreamArtifactImpact.verification: bun run check:docs and bun run check:runbooks

downstreamArtifactImpact.surface: Packages, public APIs, skills and Changesets
downstreamArtifactImpact.verification: No package, public, skill or release-train contract changes.
nonClaims: No package version, publication or public-site change is implied.

tasks.title: Automate exact-stage Preview teardown admission
tasks.goal: Let trusted PR-close cleanup start without a blind reviewer while preserving exact-stage destroy safety.
scope: current deployment automation policy, register and tests
owning architecture, authority, standard, runbook and proof
outputs: teardown external state reopened for fresh proof
post-merge retirement condition for the old environment
tasks.implementationPrompt: Keep reviewed main source, exact closed-PR and pr-N checks, non-cancellable lock, two equal dry-runs, resource allow-list, provider/state freshness and absence proof unchanged. Do not add manual recovery, change Production or expose secrets.
qualityAudits: Review the final workflow for unchanged source, stage, plan, resource, lock and absence boundaries.
Review machine inventory output so Turbo status text cannot enter JSON evidence.
Review failed-source receipt reconciliation so it cannot enter positive promotion.
Review current policy and documentation for a duplicate or stale protected-teardown claim.
Review historical Schemas and receipts for accidental rewriting.
Review the diff for Production, credential-value, Cloudflare resource or unrelated changes.

parentAudit.basis: Review the workflow diff, live names-only environment readback, policy fixtures, durable owners and post-merge proof boundary.
parentAudit.recovery: Restore the Preview reviewer and former workflow environment binding if an identity, credential or exact-stage safety mismatch appears.

completionCriteria: Focused and full local checks pass.
The candidate pull-request Quality run passes.
The Preview environment readback shows no reviewer and unchanged secret names.
After merge, a PR-close teardown starts without approval and produces accepted exact-stage absence proof before old-environment removal.
